anchors.statement: sc-lint must be a layered design.  w/ layers (lowest to highest):  a) sc-lint-types (shared types) and sc-lint-attribute (shared attributes)  b) independent cargo tools (i.e. sc-lint-boundary)  c) sc-lint cli which calls into (b)  d) just template (recommended just command layout w/ recommended mapping to (b) and (c) )
anchors.summary: Four layers: shared types/attributes, cargo tools, CLI, just template
anchors.scope: every phase-i change: architecture documentation, crate dependencies, CLI commands, and the adoption-kit just template
anchors.deterministic_check: cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps: sc-lint-boundary, sc-lint-portability and sc-lint-runtime depend on no sc-lint-* crate outside sc-lint-schema, sc-lint-directives, sc-lint-analyzer-support, sc-lint-attributes; those (a) crates depend on no (b) or (c) crate; git diff of the phase shows each change in the layer its sprint names

anchors.statement: I would expect 'just test' for the most part to be customized by the repo.
anchors.summary: just test is repo-customized, not implemented in sc-lint
anchors.scope: the adoption-kit just template and any CLI test command
anchors.deterministic_check: git diff of the phase adds no consumer test logic to crates/sc-lint; the kit justfile test recipe is a consumer-editable recipe

anchors.statement: The intent is to make these changes at the appropriate layer
anchors.summary: Each gap fix lands at its appropriate layer
anchors.scope: every phase-i sprint that addresses a GitHub issue filed by atm-core (#193-#204)
anchors.deterministic_check: git diff --stat per sprint touches only the crates or kit files of the layer the sprint names

anchors.statement: any substantial redesign work is to be discussed w/ me before documented or planned.
anchors.summary: Substantial redesign is discussed with Rand before planning
anchors.scope: all phase-i plan and documentation changes
anchors.deterministic_check: no ADR, requirement or architecture redesign lands on plan/phase-i without a recorded Rand ruling

anchors.statement: I do NOT want unauthorized additions beyond what is required to address the issues filed.
anchors.summary: No additions beyond what the filed issues require
anchors.deterministic_check: every phase-i sprint bead cites the GitHub issue (#193-#204) each deliverable addresses

anchors.statement: These should all be line item targeted additions not redesign
anchors.summary: Issue fixes are line-item targeted additions, not redesign
anchors.scope: every phase-i sprint that addresses a GitHub issue filed by atm-core
anchors.deterministic_check: git diff --stat per sprint is additive and confined to the files the issue names

anchors.statement: I want the plans to be rich with code samples so that the agent doesn't need to make decisions when developing.
anchors.summary: Sprint plans carry code samples; no dev-time decisions
anchors.scope: every phase-i sprint bead's design field
anchors.deterministic_check: each sprint bead design contains fenced code for every deliverable
